finalText:
**Fixed. All 625 tests pass.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the full pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.

```
tax = roundCents(cents * taxRate)   // wrong
tax = roundCents(discounted * taxRate)   // fixed
```

Only showed up when both discount and tax were non-zero, which is why 622 of 625 cases passed anyway.

Next: nothing, suite is green.
